style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial hand-tool e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette alternating a graphite-blue studio field #1E242B with cool light-grey information panels #E8EAEC and clean white #FFFFFF card fields, and one signal-orange accent #F26A1B reserved only for pill badges, keylines, label bars and the single CTA button; neutral tone with a cool cast on the dark fields, never warm; one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin text, bold #FFFFFF display lines on dark and #2D2D2D on light; thin single-weight line glyphs centred inside soft rounded-square tiles #D9DCDF with a subtle drop shadow, hairline #FFFFFF rules and numbered #F26A1B pill headers; hard raking side key from the upper left at about 30 degrees so moulded grip nodules, blade flanks and blasted steel shafts read as rubber and metal, soft #FFFFFF bounce fill on the shadow side, one continuous specular line per shaft, crisp contact shadow grounding every part; vertical detail-page slice layout with rounded cards, hairline dividers and left photo / right text card pairs; product always presented as a crossed pair or a parallel set at identical scale and identical hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm lifestyle cast on dark fields, no added logo or watermark, no invented figures.
noDrift: no warm lifestyle cast on the dark fields
style.presentationRules: product shown as a crossed pair or a parallel set, full grip and full shaft on the opening, variant and closing screens, a tight mid-shot of the crossed grips elsewhere, identical scale and identical hero angle across shots, #F26A1B reserved only for pill badges, keylines, label bars and the single CTA button
style.surfaceSystem: low circular pedestal #262E36 on the dark fields, matte light-grey #E8EAEC counter and clean #FFFFFF card fields on the light fields; never wood, never fabric, no lifestyle props on dark fields
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all Chinese and Latin text; bold #FFFFFF display lines on dark fields, #2D2D2D display lines on light fields, #C6CDD4 secondary lines, every rendered string a short placeholder, no dense body copy
